query: Analyze this full-stack Next.js and FastAPI repository and write a detailed technical design document in docs/architecture.md with component and sequence diagrams.
expected_behavior: Executes or references `scripts/scan_repo.py` to identify repository manifest files (`package.json`, `pyproject.toml`) and directory topology.

Produces a structured Technical Design Document matching `templates/technical-design-doc.md` containing System Overview, High-Level Architecture, Component Breakdown, API Specs, and Sequence Diagrams.
Embeds valid Mermaid diagrams for high-level architecture (`graph TD`) and client-server request execution (`sequenceDiagram`) conforming to `reference/mermaid-conventions.md`.
Documents specific FastAPI routes, Pydantic schemas, and Next.js frontend communication patterns found in the codebase.

query: Create an architecture and technical design document for our Go microservice event consumer repository.
expected_behavior: Analyzes Go entry points (`main.go`), Go module dependencies (`go.mod`), message broker bindings (Kafka/RabbitMQ/SQS), and datastore clients.
Structures the output according to the TDD template with detailed breakdowns of worker concurrency, consumer offset management, and failure/DLQ strategies.
Generates a Mermaid sequence diagram illustrating the end-to-end event consumption, message decoding, database persistence, and error handling loop.
Documents internal domain interfaces, struct definitions, configuration parameters, and telemetry metrics.

query: Generate a technical design doc for this repository. Make sure to detail all REST endpoints, database schemas, and background job flows.
expected_behavior: Identifies API routes, data models/migrations, and background queue workers across the repository files.
Constructs an exhaustive REST API specification table detailing HTTP methods, URL endpoints, request payload schemas, and response status codes.
Embeds a syntactically valid Entity-Relationship Mermaid diagram (`erDiagram`) mapping primary entities, data types, keys, and relational cardinalities.
Outlines background job execution lifecycle, operational security, and fault tolerance measures.
